title: How to register
text:
How to register
Signing up for MyINTERBOLSA is simple and secure:
Sign the service agreement
Fill in and sign Annexes I and II
Send the originals by mail
to Euronext Securities Porto
Receive activation codes
User identification code
Activation key
Confirm email
and reset password
Download the required documentation here:
